text:
alyssa (partnerships): Lockline (SI) completed KMS/HSM connector tests and basic SCIM flows. want to sync on marketplace listing + joint announcement timing. can we do a short plan here?
noah (sales-engineering): awesome — saw their integration tests. they passed key rotation + offline unwrap tests. we should lock the marketplace SKU and pricing tier first.
vikram (eng-security): from security side we still need HSM attestation docs (FIPS certs) and an ingress ACL for the private deploy path. also need an E2E test that rotates twice and verifies audit logs.
julie (product-marketing): timeline question — we were thinking a coordinated blog + marketplace tile + webinar. target date: 2/12 or 2/19? which week is safer for partners/legal?
sam (solutions): Lockline wants a co-hosted webinar w/ a demo that shows SCIM provisioning + KMS-backed secret retrieval. they can demo a Keywrap flow. prefer 2/19 to give engineering a week for final smoke tests.
alyssa (partnerships): ok tentatively 2/19. action items: (1) legal sign-off on announcement copy (julie), (2) Lockline to provide HSM attestation + KMS API contract (lockline@lockline.io) (vikram), (3) marketplace tile draft (noah), (4) internal eval customer for webinar (sam).
vikram (eng-security): quick note on the KMS API contract — we require the following headers and replay-protection: X-Request-Id, Date, and HMAC-Sig with nonce. sample snippet we validated:```json
{"kms_endpoint":"https://kms.lockline.example","wrap_key_id":"lk-01","auth":"hmac-sha256"}
```
noah (sales-engineering): marketplace SKU proposal: "lockline-integration-1.0" with add-on for 'dedicated-hsm-support'. pricing: list + custom for enterprise. I uploaded draft to: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-4822
julie (product-marketing): draft announcement copy (first pass): "Redwood + Lockline: secure key management and seamless SCIM provisioning for enterprise customers" — will share doc by EOD. tagging legal: @legal (will loop in). :eyes:
sam (solutions): small config snippet we plan to show in webinar for SCIM provisioning (just the essential bits):```yaml
scim:
  base: /scim/v2
  provisioning: true
  groups: supported
  sync_interval: 15m
```
integrations-bot: Reminder: integration-signoff checklist created: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INT-912 — status: in review.
alyssa (partnerships): meeting check — can eng provide final smoke test window next week (2/5-2/9)? vikram, can your team run rotation + audit test then?
vikram (eng-security): yes. schedule me a 2-hour block on 2/8. I'll run rotation x2 and verify audit entries and attestation validation. will post results here.
noah (sales-engineering): I'll finalize marketplace tile and ping infra for SKU provisioning.
julie (product-marketing): i'll share announcement doc now and request legal review.
sam (solutions): i'll confirm the demo customer and prep the scaffold app for the webinar.
alyssa (partnerships): great. we'll treat 2/19 as the external date, internal freeze by 2/12. if any blocker surfaces, flag here with @alyssa. :calendar:
